messages:
Clara Soto: Heads-up: two related nits in Settings > Security. 1) Region selector order vs default badge — when a region fallback is active the region label reads 'US (fallback)' and that badge pushes the KMS/Encrypt pill off the row. 2) KMS pill text 'BYOK' is being read oddly by VoiceOver and customers ask what it means. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/snap/g12k3
Ibrahim Khan: Noted. On VoiceOver 'BYOK' gets spelled out B-Y-O-K and sounds like an acronym dump. I recommend we never expose raw acronyms in isolation. Maybe 'Customer key (BYOK)' or just 'Customer-managed key'.
Mia Chen: Agreed. Copy options to consider: A) 'Customer-managed key (BYOK)' B) 'Customer key (BYOK) 1 Owner: you' C) 'Redwood-managed key' / 'Customer-managed key' binary labels. We should prefer clarity over brevity here.
Omar Reyes: Layout note: the fallback badge is dynamic and uses .badge--muted token (#6B7280) which collides with the chevron on 1024px widths. Repro: Settings > Security, set region fallback to EU, shrink width to 1024. The KMS pill drops to next line.
Ada Liu: Accessibility: if we show both pill + owner, use aria-describedby on the pill to reference the owner text, not concatenate in the accessible name. Otherwise SR reads both label+desc twice. Also ensure the pill button (if clickable) has aria-haspopup if it opens a popover.
Clara Soto: For copy and behavior: prefer Mia's C for clarity, but add hidden SR expansion. Example: visible: 'Customer-managed key' and sr-only: 'Customer-managed key. Owner: Organization X. Rotates every 90 days.' That keeps UI short but SR friendly.
Ibrahim Khan: Audit log copy is another spot. Current event string 'model invocation' sounds internal. Propose: 'Inference request logged 1 model, region, request id'. Short variant: 'Request logged (model, region)'.
Mia Chen: I'll draft exact strings in the ticket. Also recommend that the KMS pill has a popover showing: key owner, creation date, rotation policy, and a link 'View key details' that opens the key drawer. Popover must be keyboard focusable and ESC-closeable.
Omar Reyes: Visual fix: suggest reducing the fallback badge padding and switch to a concise token to avoid wrap. Or place KMS pill to the right into a separate column on narrow breakpoints. Which pattern do we prefer?
Ada Liu: Prefer keeping security controls stable in a single row for scanning. So reduce badge footprint and switch to icon+abbr on small widths (icon with aria-label='Region fallback: EU'). Ensure color token meets 4.5:1. Current fallback background #F1F5F9 + text #374151 fails for 12px. Use darker text or bolder weight.
Clara Soto: Action items: 1) Mia to add copy options in #design-ticket-2088 2) Omar to prototype compact badge + KMS placement 3) Ada to add aria pattern and SR examples in the ticket 4) Ibrahim to update audit log strings in the events schema PR.
